name: Finance & Accounting
intro: Bookkeepers, accountants and analysts who keep your books current, close the month on time and get your numbers ready for decisions.

roleDetails.text: Keeps your books current: categorizes transactions, reconciles bank and card accounts, and gets each month ready to close in QuickBooks or Xero.
Handles journal entries, account reconciliations and the month-end close, and keeps the general ledger clean for your controller or CPA.
Processes vendor bills and payment runs, sends invoices, follows up on what's overdue, and keeps both ledgers matched.
Runs payroll on schedule, tracks hours, deductions and benefits, and keeps filings in order with your payroll provider.
Builds the budgets, forecasts and monthly reports that show leadership where the money is going and what's coming next.
Owns financial reporting and the close process, sets up controls, and gives leadership a clear view of the numbers.
